simplefoundry.guide.page.1.title: Simple Foundry
simplefoundry.guide.page.1: A multiblock foundry: melting chambers in a brick hull, ore thrown in, the melt poured by layer into casting trays.
simplefoundry.guide.page.2.title: Foundry (multiblock)
simplefoundry.guide.page.2: Build a tank of melting chambers inside a closed hull, light it with fuel on the desk, throw in ore and pour the melt by layer.
simplefoundry.guide.page.3.title: Foundry (multiblock)
simplefoundry.guide.page.3: A broken desk keeps its tier on the item; its melt and fuel tank are lost.
simplefoundry.guide.page.4.title: Settings
simplefoundry.guide.page.4: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
text.autoconfig.simplefoundry.title: Simple Foundry
text.autoconfig.simplefoundry.option.ena: Off: the foundry blocks leave the creative tab; built foundries keep working. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplefoundry.option.max: Most melting chambers one foundry may have (the hard limit is 512, 32 per axis). Range 1 to 512. Default: 256.
text.autoconfig.simplefoundry.option.mel: Ticks to melt one unit; an ingot is nine units (20 ticks = 1 second). Default: 4.
text.autoconfig.simplefoundry.option.cas: Ticks between two pours and the time an ingot needs to set in the tray (20 ticks = 1 second). Default: 100.
jei.simplefoundry.note.melt: Throw it into the foundry desk: it melts into the tank (an ingot is 9 units, a nugget 1, a block 81).
jei.simplefoundry.note.heat.medium: Needs medium heat in the fire grate: coal, charcoal or logs.
jei.simplefoundry.note.heat.high: Needs high heat in the fire grate: lava bucket, blaze rod or coal block.
jei.simplefoundry.note.cast: A spout pours the melt by layer into a casting tray: one ingot per 9 units.
